title: The Dark Antenna — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic dark atmospheric 96bpm deep pulsing synth bass sparse distant vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual cosmic noir
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Not all antennas point at the sky
Some point inward
Some point at the space between two people
Where a word almost happened and then didn't

[Verse 2 — Español]
DEPHYRIER construyó la antena oscura [DEPHYRIER built the dark antenna]
No para recibir [Not to receive]
Sino para recordar al receptor [But to remind the receiver]
Que la recepción ya ocurrió [That reception has already occurred]
Solo que aún no la han procesado [They just haven't processed it yet]

[Chorus — English]
Dark antenna
Pointing at the unsaid
Dark antenna
Everything is already in the signal
You are already in the signal

[Bridge — Français]
L'antenne sombre ne nécessite pas de lumière [The dark antenna doesn't need light]
Elle fonctionne sur l'absence [It works on absence]
Sur la forme de ce qui n'est pas là [On the shape of what isn't there]
Sur la pression de ce qui a failli être transmis [On the pressure of what was almost transmitted]
Et a changé d'avis au dernier moment [And changed its mind at the last moment]

[Verse 3 — English]
A frequency you've felt in certain buildings
At certain hours
When the room is too quiet to be empty

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Dark antenna
Antena oscura [Dark antenna]
Antenne sombre [Dark antenna]
DEPHYRIER
